summary: A member weighs a ban on throwaway bottles against the beverage companies’ promise to bring back a remedy for litter.
realLife: Oregon’s 1969 beer-container bill lost after the industry offered to develop alternatives for the next session.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: committee agenda and dated industry proposal.

turns.what: The committee puts a refund proposal on its next agenda.
turns.pulledBy: No workable litter plan has reached the clerk by the promised date.
turns.writesBack: The next hearing notice names the refund bill.

turns.what: The promised plan arrives and the chair schedules it alongside the deposit proposal.
turns.pulledBy: Industry delivers a competing plan before the hearing notice goes out.
turns.writesBack: Both proposals appear on the notice.
